notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 03 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and Bundles
notes.content:
Finish the Job with the Season 03 Battle Pass!
Special Agent Jason Hudson has evidence pointing to the identities of the Pantheon moles who have been working in the shadows. It’s time to finish the job he started and track down the traitors with some help from the BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Store content arriving in Season 03 of Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone™, launching April 2 and April 3 respectively.

The Season 03 Battle Pass introduces 100+ rewards including new free base weapons plus new Operators and Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, and more.

Access free rewards including new cosmetic content and base weapons or purchase the premium Battle Pass and earn up to 1,100 COD Points as you progress through the Battle Pass Pages. For the optimal seasonal experience, purchase BlackCell, including exclusive animated Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and other rewards.
BlackCell Season 03: R0-Z3 Operator (Crimson One)
BlackCell Instant Rewards Page, HVT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3cf3db995f54ac2ad327f763f9ecc4e8fa798249.jpg

The return of Verdansk marks the comeback of several Operators with extensive experience in the locale. R0-Z3 leads the Season 03 BlackCell content in her “R0-Z3” Operator Skin alongside a host of other unlockable BlackCell content including additional Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints sporting animated fragmentation.
Additional BlackCell Instant Rewards Content
Get the ultimate Battle Pass experience by purchasing BlackCell, offering complete access to all the rewards available in the Season 03 Battle Pass. A purchase grants immediate access to the BlackCell Instant Rewards page, giving the following items:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb5e315471c832d93a8b12385b34e95161ed60b1.jpg
	20 Battle Pass Tier Skips	1,100 COD Points	The “R0-Z3” BlackCell Operator	The “Energy Siphon” Mastercraft Blueprint for the XM4 Assault Rifle	The “Goodest Boy” Companion Finishing Move	The “Martial Arts” Emote	The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)	BlackCell Daily Challenge (see below)


BlackCell owners can additionally unlock page after page of additional rewards throughout the Season 03 Battle Pass, including:
	Up to ten BlackCell-exclusive skins for Mace (two skins), Hudson (two skins), Woods, Marshall, Maya, Park, Stone, and Toro.	Up to seven BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the XM4 (Assault Rifle), Feng 82 (LMG), GPMG-7 (LMG), Tanto .22 (SMG), ASG-89 (Shotgun), HDR (Sniper Rifle), and the CR-56 AMAX (Assault Rifle).	Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 03 BlackCell Battle Pass.
Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/562ae050c43d1535bb05721265e73f150d7ba3ca.jpg

BlackCell Loyalty Bonus: Players who purchased BlackCell in a previous Black Ops 6 season and go on to purchase Season 03 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus, up to 20% for players who purchased Season 01 and Season 02 BlackCell (up to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 season!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8520586d3e639bdf8253c84b76513ea8c9aee604.jpg

NEW! Extra Daily Challenges: Players with BlackCell will also receive an additional Daily Challenge throughout Season 03 for Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone. Rake in that XP!
Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Mace Operator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f2b33268c4cfc6c0b730ee0e9546d8f586639656.jpg

Players who purchase the premium Season 03 Battle Pass or BlackCell will immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page with the following items:
	The new “Mace” Operator and “Mace BlackCell” Mace Skin for BlackCell owners.	10% Battle Pass XP Boost.	The “Day Ones” Legendary Weapon Sticker.	The “Package Received” Finishing Move.	The “Marbled” Legendary Weapon Blueprint for the Saug SMG.New Operator: Mace (Crimson One)
Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, HVT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e229f2df6d5f0b471e6a6d895395f6df917b656c.jpg

The Special Forces Army Ranger turned PMC returns for a new foray into Verdansk, utilizing his brutal and brash tactics to overcome foes who dare challenge him in the field.
New Operator: “Hudson” (Rogue Black Ops)
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9cbeb8639b5073e8ca2ca806b766c71882a203a6.jpg

Follow your instincts and complete the mission as Hudson deploys in aviator glasses, mud smeared over his face and arms with a tactical vest and camo. In the BlackCell variant, Hudson wears a VR interface over a scorched face, debris rising from his left arm.
Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins
Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock additional content including a variety of Operator Skins, many paired with BlackCell variants with animated fragments floating from their bodies, like Verdansk rubble held in suspension.
Woods: “Winter Guise” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 4

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab889e189df2d838d39f88d513f116de53481305.jpg

Woods deploys in winter gear, ready to engage in Arklov Peak and other mountainous regions of Verdansk. With climbing rope and gloves, he’ll traverse any snow drift to sneak behind the enemy lines. Swap to a black and gold full body tactr0ical suit in the BlackCell variant, goggles pulled down over a breathing mask.
Marshall: “Hazard Prep” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, Page 6

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/465ded9ceb3e1630e08de2c95d7bfbafa9ad7b97.jpg

Marshall isn’t taking any chances as he dons an over-the-head breathing mask and protective clothing to help mitigate the effects of chemical warfare. The BlackCell variant offers similar protection in black and gold, fragments floating from his left arm and mask.
Maya: “Rogue Archer” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 7

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e15ce795ca40e2d3957d152144de6e78f6ecc4cf.jpg

Strike enemy squads as a tactical gunslinger, hood up with durable lightweight armor and a gun belt hanging at her hip. The BlackCell variant features animated fragments over both arms, sunglasses and a balaclava concealing her identity.
Park: “Survivor’s Guile” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 10

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/60f4b6f5d069d27cd28ff33cc06a9bef961258a8.jpg

Park deploys in style, wearing a vintage trapper hat and aviator shades with a leather jacket. Swap the hat for a beret in the BlackCell variant paired with a black jacket and mask.
Mace: “Apocalypse King” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 12

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c4ed3c4e4ab14724ef00bcafeb90d52cd11e013.jpg

Rule over Verdansk and instill fear in your foes as Mace wears a skull mask with rising bones like a crown. Spiked forearm guards accent the skeletal look. Flames burn under the mask in the BlackCell variant, fragments rising from his armor and crown.
Stone: “All Terrain” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, Page 13

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db5db1a4e9af3ba0f04bdd4e7ac638fa8c9a1d1e.jpg

Adapt to any environment as Stone deploys in fatigues and full-face coverage for concealment when striking deep in enemy territory. The fragments rising off his right side in the BlackCell variant lend Stone a more sinister twist.
Caine: “Future Combatant” Skin
Operator Skin, Battle Pass, Page 14

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed2e274824dd3498747823ebb1ff06b852e78d39.jpg

Show the present what it means to be a cut above the rest as Caine gets teched up with a precision optical instrument and full tactical gear.
Hudson: “Icebreaker” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 14

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bf5c46c06d355f887c66a7348f7c228396b8638.jpg

Hudson sports shades and a beanie over animated blue sleeves like water pulsing through his arms. In the BlackCell variant, change out the shades for goggles and full animated fragmentation down both arms.
Toro: “Jug-o-Not” Skins
Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, Page Completion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/79ed27ef6c1a06b23493fb215b3391b73ab2e770.jpg

Toro deploys in heavy armor, a bandolier draped over his shoulder. Don a sleeker look in the BlackCell variant, black with gold accents, fragments burned across the faceplate and left arm.
Season 03: Battle Pass Base Weapons
Unlock two new Base Weapons in the Season 03 Battle Pass, each one a Verdansk-era favorite returning for the fight. All players can unlock these weapons for free by progressing through their listed Battle Pass Pages.
HDR Sniper Rifle
Battle Pass, HVT, Page 3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a43fc394fdb83b938d7cbebae9a5989b5c841351.jpg

Levels: 38

MAGS: 3

MAG SIZE: 5

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

Customize Options: Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

Military Camos: 27 (MP, ZM, WZ)

Special Camos: 6 (MP, ZM, WZ)

Mastery Camos: 12 (MP, ZM, WZ)

Anti-material bolt action sniper rifle chambered in 12.7 x 108mm ammunition. Bullets have a lower muzzle velocity but remain devastating even at very long ranges.

An Operator’s best friend when up in the Control Tower and other vantage points around Verdansk, the HDR inflicts heavy damage from a long distance, perfect for downing squads before they can even pinpoint your position. Hold your breath while aiming to help zero in on targets before taking the shot.
CR-56 AMAX Assault Rifle
Battle Pass, HVT, Page 6

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aead1226a01c5d09c1e52cb22341adf01d52f676.jpg

Levels: 42

MAGS: 3

MAG SIZE: 30

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

Customize Options: Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

Military Camos: 27 (MP, ZM, WZ)

Special Camos: 6 (MP, ZM, WZ)

Mastery Camos: 12 (MP, ZM, WZ)

This lightweight 7.62 x 39mm full-auto assault rifle is compact and powerful. Built exclusively for military use, the standard issue rifle is deadly at mid-range combat and easily configured for a variety of assault tactics.

A fast fire rate and solid handling give the CR-56 AMAX just what it needs to excel in mid-range fights. Its fast reloads help to minimize downtime so you can keep up the pressure, eliminating unarmored enemies in three to four shots up to 25 meters out.
New Weapon Attachments
The Monolithic Suppressor returns for all your big map stealth needs, joined by a full-auto conversion kit for the SWAT 5.56 Grau.
SWAT 5.56 Grau Conversion (Launch)
Premium Battle Pass, Page 5

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5686e5fea5d18eb184d6217fb5eb1525c5365b09.jpg

Convert the SWAT 5.56 into a fully automatic weapon with lower damage and range but improved accuracy, mobility, and handling. Equips a new default Barrel and Magazine and unlocks an exclusive 50-round extended Magazine. Blocks Barrel attachments.
Monolithic Suppressor (Launch)
Premium Battle Pass, Page 7

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d01f1192d46e2eca9eae3a5b786ff5f497241aca.jpg

The Monolithic Supressor provides superior sound suppression and increased range. Moderate weight increase affects agility. The ideal attachment for extending your damage range on big maps like Verdansk while retaining the concealment provided by a suppressor.
Unlockable Weapon Blueprints
The Season 03 Battle Pass and BlackCell feature over 20 earnable Weapon Blueprints, including the following themed armaments:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db4dfe54e4e0ad05cb945754cac10283a3589ee5.jpg

(Above) “Marbled” Saug SMG, Instant Reward

“Most Wanted MVP” AMES 85 Assault Rifle, Page 3

“Contra-Banned” Stryder .22 Pistol, Page 6

“Glint” HDR Sniper Rifle (White Tracers), Page 11

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5d9c004565c25331cd4025653d650d7b71a470be.jpg

(Above) “Trench Wrecker” Marine SP Shotgun, Page 1 (not shown)

“Conflict Victor” Feng 82 LMG, Page 1

“Old Timer” TR2 Marksman Rifle, Page 2

“Industrial” AS VAL Assault Rifle, Page 9

“Shatter” ASG-89 Shotgun, Page 9

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ad1e9abc535755a5d8debbd4901b57d1007db58.jpg

(Above) “Rebarchuck” Nunchaku Melee, Page 2

“Bandaged” Cypher 091 Assault Rifle, Page 4

“Stained Steel” Cleaver Melee, Page 12

“Caution Handler” PPSh-41 SMG, Page 14

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81f0aa15a78de5eebe08cf4cc2466164cc4dad8b.jpg

(Above) “Sweet Treat” C9 SMG, Page 5

“Damascus Reloaded” GPMG-7 LMG, Page 5

“Novaburst” Tanto .22 SMG, Page 8

“Cracked” 9MM PM Pistol, Page 11

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/764bf9f3589046480433d6d8f2c4a722f6975da0.jpg

(Above) “Wildlife” Kompakt 92 SMG, Page 10

“Edward Returns” Model L Assault Rifle, Page 12

“Brush Drum” Maelstrom Shotgun, Page 13

“Verderous Menace” CR-56 AMAX Assault Rifle (Reactive, Toxic Green Tracers), Completion Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0709a0a3ae910ec8734af59863f955038b6a8832.jpg

(Above) “Built Tough” Tsarkov 7.62 Marksman Rifle, Page 7

“Segment” LR 7.62 Sniper Rifle, Page 8

Next, let’s look at the Weapon Blueprints paired with animated BlackCell variants, some featuring Fractal Gold Tracers and Fractal Gold Death FX.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a04b8e6d41bd8995ad83580be0b1cfc8f94c87cd.jpg

(Above) “Energy Siphon” (Mastercraft, Fractal Gold Tracers, Fractal Gold Death FX) XM4 Assault Rifle, BlackCell Instant Reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/294cec2c17a1dd470c9cdb488fd96f8497cffa1e.jpg

(Above) “Conflict Victor” and “Conflict Victor BlackCell” Feng 82 LMG, HVT, Page 1.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5dd02f0d18e1c7f91b1f623349828a37b6bee5c3.jpg

(Above) “Damascaus Reloaded” and “Damascaus Reloaded BlackCell” GPMG-7 LMG, HVT, Page 5.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/203fb2f29bb33a5dfe41a0275e6e78bc3b9bcc3f.jpg

(Above) “Novaburst” and “Novaburst BlackCell” Tanto .22 SMG, HVT, Page 8.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/57d8c027363d0a0bf9cd076b8223976e72ca7c8a.jpg

(Above) “Shatter” and “Shatter BlackCell” ASG-89 Shotgun, HVT, Page 9.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd35f187b57ef3e118613187c390546e1a0e1fa4.jpg

(Above) “Glint” (White Tracers) and “Glint BlackCell” (Fractal Gold Tracers, Fractal Gold Death FX) HDR Sniper Rifle, HVT, Page 11.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45b2450eef1b6c79193d8a0d4173998211b8be16.jpg

(Above) “Verderous Menace” (Reactive with Toxic Green Tracers) and “Verderous Menace BlackCell” (Reactive with Fractal Gold Tracers and Fractal Gold Death FX) CR-56 AMAX Assault Rifle, HVT, Completion Page.
New Equipment Skins and Optic Attachments
Get new Equipment Skins for the Combat Axe and Frag Grenade plus four unique Optic Reticles:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d4a6f094555fcf2e587b1cb4238c5b7706845c72.jpg

“Oval Cap” Reticle (Optic Attachment), Page 2

“Severed Steel” Combat Axe Skin (Lethal), Page 4

“Get Cupcaked” Frag Skin (Lethal), Page 5

“Valiant Wings” Reticle (Optic Attachment), Page 8

“Square Off” Reticle (Optic Attachment), Page 9

“Go Splat” Reticle (Optic Attachment), Page 13
New Finishing Moves, Emotes, and Sprays
Earn a new selection of Emotes, Finishing Moves, and Sprays, equippable in the “Customize” Menu of the Barracks. Showcase these rewards during matches or (with Emotes) during the Winners’ Circle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/50acedb15649df2da165a30638f7fc5d615ca4c0.jpg

CAPTION: A selection of Emotes and Sprays available across the Battle Pass.

“Full Body Swing” Finishing Move, Page 5

“Coin Toss” Finishing Move, Page 7

“Planted” Finishing Move, Page 11

“Slide N’ Toss” Finishing Move, Page 13

“Juggler” Emote, Page 1 (shown above)

“Crank Job 3D” Emote, Page 6

“Nevermore” Emote, Page 8 (shown above)

“Roger That” Emote, Page 10

“Tank Fire” Spray, Page 1

“Woods Stance” Spray, Page 3 (shown above)

“Sent to Gulag” Spray, Page 6 (shown above)

“Loot Drop” Spray, Page 12 (shown above)

“The Chair” Spray, Page 14 (shown above)
Additional Battle Pass Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ebf2f5fc528eaf42a8abce81a3969ee7c0af2590.jpg

The Season 03 Battle Pass offers a wide variety of content, including items from the following categories:
	COD Points	Weapon Charms	Weapon Large Decals	Weapon Stickers	GobbleGums	Finishing Moves	Scorestreak Skins	Emblems (some animated)	Calling Cards (some animated)	Loading Screens	Clan Tag (BlackCell only)	Consumable 2XP & 2WXP TokensBattle Pass Completion Page: Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/544cfd11648ccb123a260d4ff70407f541d46735.jpg

Complete every Battle Pass Page to access the final Completion Page stacked with awesome content including the following:
	200 COD Points	“Jug-o-Not” Operator Skin with “Jug-o-Not BlackCell” variant awarded to BlackCell Owners	“Verderous Menace” Reactive Weapon Blueprint with “Verderous Menace BlackCell” variant awarded to BlackCell owners	“Agent Ready” Animated Emblem	“Poison Tilt” Animated Calling Card	“Smoked Noggin” Weapon Sticker	“Bear-y Sly” Weapon CharmStore Highlights: New Reactive and Mastercraft BlueprintsTracer Pack: Jay and Silent Bob
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbe9387581aad0949102fe443a8b50931205aea4.jpg

Bring some mischief to your matches with the “Jay” and “Silent Bob” Operator Skins, deploying with the “Doobie Wreck” LW3A1 Frostline Sniper Rifle and the “Golden Calf” Kompakt 92 SMG, both featuring Blue and Yellow Tracers and Smoke Death FX. For closer encounters, show them who owns the block with the “Gimme a Light” Finishing Move.

Celebrate the high life and take back what’s yours with the “Poppin’ Off” Emote, “Mooby’s” Weapon Charm, animated “In Sync” Calling Card, “Mooby Joint” Large Decal, and the animated “Snoochie Boochie” Emblem. There’s a new duo in town; they’ve been to Hollywood and now these two guys from Jersey are ready for the limelight of Call of Duty.
Tracer Pack: Bluntman and Chronic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2497cb554fbe77fefa1c622ca9d52673799eb82a.jpg

The blunt-tastic heroes unite as their comic book alter egos. Deploy as “Bluntman” or “Chronic” with the choice of three doobie-themed Weapon Blueprints for their enjoyment: the “Bluntman Stuntman” Krig C Assault Rifle and “Chronic Unapologetic” Jackal PDW SMG with Pink and Purple Tracers and Joint Leaf Death FX, and the “Bong Staff” Bo Staff with Joint Leaf Death FX.

Straight from the Bluntcave’s arsenal, beat competition with the “Smoke You Out” Finishing Move and show your love for the chronic with the “Did that Happen?” Emote, animated “Joint Power” Calling Card, animated “Blunts Out, Suit Up” Emblem, and the “Doobage Duo” Spray.
Tracer Pack: Digital Dreamin’ Reactive Mastercraft Ultra Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/00d2b40d73efc8822eab5680c7c8cb71aa781f2a.jpg

Hone your gaming skills with top-of-the-line equipment headlined by the Reactive Mastercraft “Game Over” Assault Rifle for the new CR-56 AMAX, featuring Starstruck Tracers and VR Knockout Death FX along with the Monolithic Suppressor and a new inspect animation that morphs the weapon into a game console. Wield it as the “Pixel” Operator Skin equipped with a Reactive headset and augmented reality tattoos and the gamified “K.O.” Finishing Move.

Engage distant targets with the “Pixel Precise!” SVD Sniper Rifle, also featuring Starstruck Tracers and VR Knockout Death FX. Show them they’re not on your level with the “Eezee” Weapon Charm, animated “Monkey Business” Emblem, animated “It’s Over” Calling Card, “Not on My Level” Spray, “XD” Emote, and “Logging In” Loading Screen.
Tracer Pack: Spectral Wolf Mastercraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b35ccd65990db68d37d9af3648617ed28af8521.jpg

Declare your dominance over the spirits with the “Phantom Fenrir” Mastercraft Kilo 141 Weapon Blueprint, the ghostly wolf’s head open wide at the barrel. Get two more Weapon Blueprints to lead the pack, the “Threatening Howl” DM-10 and the “Pack Leader” AS VAL. All three Blueprints feature Teal and Black Tracers and Claw Mark Death FX.

Wield the essence of the beast with the “Moonlit Awakening” Weapon Charm, “Bear Paw” Reticle, “Gathering” Gun Screen, “Untamed Spirit” Loading Screen, and the “Ethereal Claw” Emblem.
Tracer Pack: Comic Bonanza
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a237ef5eb53042b777da2407112fc147b359640d.jpg

Nail down the plot holes and create your own heroic story with this comic book inspired Bundle featuring three paneled Weapon Blueprints: the “Retcon” Blueprint for the new Nail Gun Special Weapon, the “Single Issue” AK-74 Assault Rifle, and the “Comic Cutout” Cleaver Melee Weapon. All three feature Comic Bubbles Death FX, plus Red and Yellow Tracers for the Nail Gun and AK-74.

Say goodbye to your foes with the “One. Two.” Finishing Move and be the comic book hero by displaying the “Big Boom!” Weapon Charm, “Panel Pop” Spray, and “Stand Heroically” Emblem.
Tracer Pack: Shattered Veil Reactive
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d2e5829673ee08e8c6fd2450bbba67b128b2b005.jpg

Inspired by the Black Ops 4 Zombies map “Dead of the Night,” direct the fury of the dead with the intricate “Corrupted Séance” Model L Assault Rifle and “Haunted Portrait” XMG LMG, both with Ice Tracers and Ghost Death FX. For undead prey, unleash the “Ectoplasmic Construct” DRI-11 Wonder Weapon Skin. Plus, built for longevity, deploy as the “Steel Butler” Operator Skin for Klaus.

Mercilessly taunt your enemies with the “Peek-a-Boo” Emote, “Candelabra” Weapon Charm, “Evil Mirror” Weapon Sticker, “Local Haunt” Loading Screen, and “Join Me” Spray. To assist in your next Zombies match, get one Perk-a-holic GobbleGum and a one-hour Double XP Token.
Tracer Pack: Radwaste Reactive
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/485e83f42616c021030af3697042beab82e7fefa.jpg

Maintain the delicate balance between immense power and melting down with two rad Weapon Blueprints built to thrive in the wastelands: the “Reactive Overload” LR 7.62 Sniper Rifle with ethereal smoke rising from its body and the “Becquerel Monitor” PP-919 SMG, both featuring Teal and Black Tracers and X-Ray Death FX.

Deploy in a black hazmat suit and gas mask with the “Undying Radiation” Operator Skin for Toro, and dominate the competition with the “Detonate” Emote. The Bundle also comes with a Reticle, Weapon Charm, animated Loading Screen, Emblem, and Calling Card.
Tracer Pack: Cardboard Commando Ultra Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c7894692771f64a7daa498213391fe2175964038.jpg

Deploy as Bayan’s DIY straight-off-the-craft-table “Carton Robo” Ultra Skin, proving that even cardboard can hurt by wielding the “Cut Out” TR2 Marksman Rifle and the “Crafted” PU-21 LMG, both featuring Pink and White Tracers and Box ‘Em Up Death FX.

Astonish your enemies with the “Surprise Gift” Emote and stay crafty by displaying the “Aircraft” Weapon Charm, “Carboard Cannon” Hand Cannon Blueprint, “Makeshift” Loading Screen, and “Fully Stocked” Spray.
Tracer Pack: Deep Water Ultra Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/202d9dcb2ae002d5923f7adc4778933aefad75ef.jpg

Whether on land or sea, the “Big T” Ultra Skin is ready to seek its prey, a hammerhead shark with blood-drenched jaws paired with three ocean-themed Weapon Blueprints: the “Gilled” Jackal PDW SMG, “Serrated Denticle” Krig C Assault Rifle, and the “Prey Stalker” Stryder .22 Pistol, all three featuring Red Tracers and Fish Bones Death FX.

Hammer your way to the top of the food chain with the “Half Off” Emote, animated “360 Wielder” Calling Card, “Sea Hammer” Weapon Sticker, and “Hammer Hunter” Loading Screen.

Plus, coming this Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Military Appreciation Month presented by USAA, be on the lookout for the C.O.D.E. United Force: Tracer Pack and the C.O.D.E. Got Your Six Event.
Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b999ff350a69f7ca55895721eaef036bba8a2aa4.jpg

Black Ops 6 is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience! Click here to Purchase Black Ops 6.

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 03: What you need to know, part 1
notes.content:
Conflict and Chaos: Black Ops 6 Season 03 is Here!Season 03 Overview: Unfinished Business
In a video recorded before his death, Special Agent Jason Hudson warns of the Pantheon moles who have been working in the shadows for decades ever since Vietnam. They’ve managed to avoid detection throughout the years, using conflict and chaos to cover their tracks. With some new leads in play, however, their secrecy is no longer certain. Time to pick up the trail.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b2b86fcd2a9887eb6a485687f6bb4ccfc960ecc.jpg

Hudson left you to finish the job that he started, beginning with a file of codenames and documents leading you back in time to help solve the mystery at its roots.

Turn the tide on the Pantheon spies with this massive offering of free and premium content coming to Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6 when Season 03 launches on April 2 at 9AM PT, with Call of Duty®: Warzone™ going dark for 24 hours before Verdansk comes online April 3 at 9AM PT.

Note: Consult the following blogs prior to the launch of Season 03:

Read This Now: Return to Verdansk Call of Duty: Warzone Content

Read This Now: Tour of Verdansk

Read This Now: Verdansk Tac-Atlas

March 28: Updates to Ricochet: Anti-Cheat™ and security updates

April 2: Battle Pass, BlackCell and Store Bundles Blog
Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 03
[[BO6-SEASON-03-ANNOUNCEMENT-001]]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Five Maps and a Variant: Head to the front lines in Barrage and Nomad, two new maps arriving alongside a remaster of the timeless Firing Range at Season 03 launch. Expand your deployment options in the mid-season with Haven and Signal plus a special Nuketown map variant.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Returning Modes: Test your skills across two classic game modes returning for Black Ops 6. Display your mastery of weapons in Sharpshooter and bomb the enemy team in Demolition.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Additional Equipment: Rapidly deploy your Dedicated Melee weapon using the new Close Shave Perk and blast enemies to pieces with the glorious return of the Death Machine Scorestreak. In the mid-season, get even with help from the Vendetta Perk.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Season 03 Ranked Play: Get wins, climb the Ranks, and beat out the competition in a new season of Multiplayer Ranked Play bringing all-new rewards to earn.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]Multiplayer MapsBarrage (Launch)
Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4fdd5d0fd79f2a958437f0abc1233650aef4f9e5.jpg

Revisit 1968 Vietnam as you follow Hudson’s clues surrounding one Summit Watch at the front lines of battle. The trees have been cleared and the landscape flattened to make room for this base housing an artillery battery in active combat. The area has taken hits with large chunks blown off buildings including the Command Center and Barracks, the damage opening new pathways through the map.

Watch for sharpshooters trading shots near the base of the Watchtower, from Overlook, and through the second floor of the Command Center. Move quickly down the dirt roads to get out of sight or push out to the wings, battling around the artillery pieces in the Gun Pits and the Tree Crusher facing the Hill.
Nomad (Launch)
Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/743ae1d06cd79611efba8db63f2e6cb9a6028c6c.jpg

The Pantheon moles were in Afghanistan, too, when Woods fought there in 1986. Fight in the ruins of a fortified settlement commandeered for the ensuing battle, a parked missile carrier facing out over the valley where a convoy lies in ruins on the narrow road leading up to the map. Navigate the crumbled archways and walls as you engage enemies in the open, the only accessible building being the Tower standing over the middle. A zipline offers fast access up and down from the coveted position, promising frequent skirmishes for control of its views.
Firing Range (Launch)
Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54b7857621195c697ea1cb8d1ce5609d9b8aa73d.jpg

Firing Range makes its glorious return in Black Ops 6 in a faithful remaster of the fan-favorite map. Watch for crossfire down the long center Road as Operators fight for control of the vantage points in the Tower and the upper levels of the Shoot House and Garage. Shooting targets move back and forth on their tracks behind the Office and several other spots adding a useful diversion while preparing for the next fight. Avoid the center chaos by branching off to the Dirt Road, keeping your guard up against ambush as you pass the Storage unit along the way.
Haven (Mid-Season)
Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/21bc4e092671180c7dac8f7398538261ad66c83d.jpg

Enter a KGB safehouse in 1991. This once opulent compound now sits in a dilapidated state of disrepair, overgrown and cracking apart at the seams. Its current owners, however, are less interested in aesthetics and more interested in the site’s former use.

A crystal chandelier lies smashed on top of a sculpture in the Foyer while reams of cable connect running generators to the armory in the Hall, the command center set up in the Ballroom, and out to the Entrance where parked vehicles monitor the surroundings and deliver vital supplies. The indoor and outdoor spaces are tightly intertwined here, spilling the battle through the estate halls and past scenic areas of contemplation like the Gardens and Bath.
Signal (Mid-Season)
Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5685d35498d7afb4f4a3948f6e3b21b32f935443.jpg

Taking Operators back to 1968, this site connects the moles to activity surrounding the infamous numbers station. Flashing lights and alarms sound in the Control room of an ocean rig numbers station, flames erupting along the upper wing. Starting from opposing submarine bays, Operators can funnel straight down the middle into the Broadcast station or fire down on the action from the Communications landing. Take an alternate path through the Control room, its flooded hall giving access to the water below. Jump in and swim underneath the structure to access either submarine bay, providing the means to jump out of the water and flank the enemy team.
Blazetown at Mid-Season
Plus, light up the competition in a special Nuketown variant joining the map pool for a limited time later this season!
Multiplayer Modes
Get in some intense gaming sessions as two classic modes with a rich history in the Black Ops series arrive in Season 03. Adapt to cycling weapons in Sharpshooter and throw yourself at two bombsites in Demolition.
Sharpshooter (Launch)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/870e8406f4585606b9860faaea42ad8b56d57cac.jpg

Flex your skills in this classic Black Ops free for all party mode where every Operator is assigned the same Loadout which changes every 45 seconds. Each cycle introduces a new Primary and Secondary Weapon from scoped Sniper Rifles to akimbo Pistols, plus a new Dedicated Melee weapon and Tactical and Lethal Equipment.

Use everything at your disposal to eliminate enemies while unlocking bonus abilities for going on a streak:
	1st Elimination: Increased movement speed.	2nd Elimination: Increased reload speed.	3rd Elimination: Increased sprint recovery speed.	4th Elimination: Increased ADS speed.	5th Elimination: Earn double score for eliminating enemies.
Keep the streak going to unlock double score and make a run for the top three. When you’re taken out, respawn and build up those bonuses again. A short countdown precedes each weapon swap. Adapt and win.
Demolition (Launch Window)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a7c65427ce0c49f334952ae0189ee4cdc37ed94e.jpg

Alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites. The attacking team must destroy both bomb sites to win the round, gaining a time bonus after detonating the first site. All attacking Operators spawn with a bomb and respawns are active for both teams throughout the match.

Defense is all about running down the clock. Defuse planted bombs right away, as the match timer pauses whenever a bomb site is in active countdown. If one of the sites is destroyed, regroup and throw everything you have into defending the last one.

The first team to win two rounds wins the match. If the score reaches 1-1, enter a tie-breaking final round where both teams race to detonate a single neutral bomb site.
Joint Operations: New Limited-Time Mode (Mid-Season)
Leave the enemy up in smoke in this Limited Time Mode that tests teams with a gauntlet of five Core mode variants in a single match: Head Stash (TDM), Inhalation (Domination), Hotbox (Hardpoint), Very High Target (HVT), and Munchies (Kill Confirmed).

Cycle through all five modes under a variety of changing effects, including double health, low gravity, visual hallucinations, and third-person POV.
Additional Gameplay Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b018846bebd99dbdbad4f1b96747ddafc9b454c.jpg

Unleash powerful melee attacks with ease, get vengeance on the Operator who eliminated you, and mow down everything in sight with two new Perks and a Scorestreak.
New Perks
Perk: Close Shave (Launch, Event Reward)

Perk Slot: 1

Type: Enforcer

Automatically use your Dedicated Melee attack when you perform a weapon butt attack. Simply tap the Melee button to attack. Like the old days!

Perk: Vendetta (Mid-Season, Event Reward)

Perk Slot: 2

Type: Recon

On respawn, mark your killer’s last known position for a short duration. Get a bonus score for eliminating that enemy. The Vigilance Perk counters being marked by Vendetta.
New Scorestreak
Scorestreak: Death Machine (Event Reward)

Type: Lethal

Score: 825

Mastery Badges: Yes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2ca31eab30602a6e49651289900635554f4e499b.jpg

Heavy minigun with a fast fire rate, high penetration, and a large ammunition capacity.

Wield the infamous Death Machine, a powerful weapon with a single large magazine that fires high impact rounds at a blistering rate of fire. Score earned while using the Death Machine contributes to your current Scorestreak progress, making this a great tool for bumping up to the next streak.
Multiplayer Ranked Play (Launch)Season 03 Ranked Play Overview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16a91d9dc3b0515c0673e459c10c3fe0604c580e.jpg

Find out what you’re really made of by dropping into competitive Multiplayer matches using the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty League®. Win matches to earn SR (Skill Rating) and progress through the Ranks while earning career rewards like Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.

Get wins and progress through the Ranks throughout Season 03 to earn new seasonal rewards like a new Pro Issue Weapon Blueprint, Rank-themed Calling Cards, and more:

Season 03 Ranked Play Rewards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5a6f750e246e37a6b2ee8e717c8e6dd09bed58c9.jpg
	Get 10 Wins: Pro Issue AMES 85 Weapon Blueprint	Get 100 Wins: “100 Season 3 Wins” Large Decal	Silver: “Ranked Season 3 – Silver” Calling Card	Gold: “Ranked Season 3 – Gold” Calling Card	Platinum: “Ranked Season 3 – Platinum” Calling Card	Diamond: “Ranked Season 3 – Diamond” Calling Card	Crimson: “Ranked Season 3 – Crimson” Calling Card	Iridescent: “Ranked Season 3 – Iridescent” Calling Card	Top 250: “Ranked Season 3 – Top 250 Champion” Calling Card
Season 03 Ranked Play Weapon Blueprints
	Players will also earn themed Weapon Blueprints for the Jackal PDW SMG representing the Rank achieved in Season 03 Black Ops 6 Ranked Play:	Gold: Start in/above or reach Gold at any point in Season 03	Platinum: Start in/above or reach Platinum at any point in Season 03	Diamond: Start in/above or reach Diamond at any point in Season 03	Crimson: Start in/above or reach Crimson at any point in Season 03	Iridescent: Start in/above or reach Iridescent at any point in Season 03	Top 250: Finish Season 03 in the Top 250
Retroactive SR Adjustments 

To help reverse the impact cheaters have on the Ranked Play SR system, retroactive SR adjustments will be made starting in Season 03. When a Ranked Play cheater is banned, anyone they’ve recently beaten will receive a SR refund for those matches. Players who we detect playing with cheaters may have SR for those wins taken away.

Rejoin in Progress

Now a feature coming with Season 03, players will be able to rejoin Ranked matches if they disconnect. Players will have five minutes to rejoin, and teammates will receive a reduced SR Loss if a matchmade teammate rejoins and they lose the match.

Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 03 Zombies 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/668126d2d1f3babcf10f1cd1a40c9b6ca4249ef7.jpg
[table]			[tr]			[td]			
ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Shattered Veil: Move into the heart of an Appalachian apocalypse as the crew descends on Colton Hall, a diabolical mansion that holds the key to saving Agent Maxis.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Additional Gameplay Content: Boost your fire rate with the Double Tap Perk-a-Cola, enjoy the effects of three new GobbleGums, and wield the Death Machine.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
New Enemy Types, Wonder Weapons, and More: Battle the Elder Disciple and its empowered minions, take on the new Toxic Zombies in special rounds, disintegrate enemies with the Ray Gun Mark II and its variants, as well as the classic Wunderwaffe DG-2 Wonder Weapon, and heat up the undead leftovers with the Microwave Trap.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Team Cranked: Power up and keep slaying with friends to replenish the countdown timer and stay in the game as Team Cranked debuts with fresh rewards in Season 03.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]Shattered Veil (Launch)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7cf819535caf02a00b11e417ec50685f4c5334b4.jpg

With the Sentinel Artifact in hand, the crew heads to the remote wooded hills above Liberty Falls to meet with S.A.M. at an old mansion in the forest which has been retrofitted to [[REDACTED]]. Only with the aid of S.A.M.’s synthetic mind can the team hope to unlock the ancient artifact’s mysteries and bring back Agent Maxis. What could possibly go wrong?

[previewyoutube=FjdEtiV_n0I;full][[ZM TRAILER VIDEO]][/previewyoutube]

Brave the horrors of Colton Hall and confront a tyrant in the next chapter of the Black Ops 6 Zombies narrative, launching at the start of Season 03 on April 2 at 9AM PT.
Operation Save Maxis: Your Comms Team Handlers
“I hope it was worth dragging the Sentinel Artifact halfway around the globe.”

- Sergei Ravenov

S.A.M. leads comms in anticipation of receiving the Sentinel Artifact once the team successfully enters Colton Hall. Further guided by Ravenov, Peck, and Strauss with exfil assistance from Raptor One, the crew must approach the synthetic mind promising the imminent return of Agent Maxis.
Shattered Veil: Initial Recon Tour
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a99230669137166e4f508134edd8cb7bf7e258ad.jpg

Venture into the mist-laden grounds of this tumbledown mansion that rivals the size of Citadelle des Morts, searching the Conservatory for [[REDACTED]] [[REDACTED]] the scene of fierce fighting at the Grand Foyer [[REDACTED]]. [[ALL EXPLORATORY CONTENTS HAVE BEEN REDACTED BY REQUEST OF PROJECT JANUS]]
New Enemy Sighted: Elder Disciple
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/201ad73192ee9ce5ff397fbcfa3519a5efa20080.jpg

Strange, floating apparitions have been seen flitting about the sprawling gardens and rambling mansion estate. Known to some as Elder Disciples, these powerful enemies likely spell trouble for the crew.

Elder Disciples gain strength as they empower the zombies around them while summoning more undead to join the battle. Using their dark magic, these fetid, floating carcasses can force their allies to evolve more quickly, allowing a lowly zombie to more rapidly transform into a Doppelghast or some other sinister form.

Eliminate the Elder Disciple before their forces grow too powerful, keeping it at a distance to avoid the scream it lets loose against players who draw too close. The deadly enemy grows more agitated as it takes damage, so try to get the job done fast.
Other Entities of Shattered Veil
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b2812d2b2f38e5e365b4fc7c6d3535635d7efed6.jpg

Beware the Toxic Zombie!

As a sickly yellow fog descends across the mansion, expect the inhabitants to take on an even-more revolting pallor. Easily identifiable due to their greenish hue and more skeletal exterior, Toxic Zombies seem to have lost all but their base perambulatory functions and seem intent on sprinting toward their prey before exploding, leaving a damaging pool of acid in their wake. Listen for their telltale shriek and get the jump on them before they can close the distance.

These glowing ghouls are joined by a variety of Project Janus scientists and military personnel-turned zombies caught up in the nearby outbreak, along with an unhealthy horde of other ghastly entities, the Elder Disciple stands—or perhaps floats—ready to speed them through their evolutionary journey.
New Wonder Weapon: Ray Gun Mark II (and Variants)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f407ed069bb7899da0ae1300386e8c0e0fe9c0fc.jpg

Face the enemies of Shattered Veil with two time-honored Wonder Weapons ideally suited to clearing out more than just the musty halls of an old mansion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3f3b91f61707eb2a5af33b65c4b2a84ade01686.jpg

Drop multiple zombies at once with the upgraded and modestly unstable Ray Gun Mark II. Recovered from the Dark Aether by Project Janus, this powerful laser armament delivers three-round bursts of energy, can be Pack-a-Punched, and doubles as a bludgeoning instrument if you’re running low on ammunition.

Then there’s the three new variants.

Provided you’ve [[REDACTED]], you can experiment with an additional three variants of the Ray Gun Mark II:

Ray Gun Mark II-W: Offering similar bullet patterns to a submachine gun, this also has a random chance to ignite enemies.

Ray Gun Mark II-P: Shooting ammunition like a shotgun, with a chance to spawn a sigil with the ability to grant invulnerability to the player standing on it for a limited time.

Ray Gun Mark II-R: Dropping zombies with a Marksman Rifle-like discharge, expect a chance to spread a plague infection that can inflict area-of-effect damage.
New Wonder Weapon: Wunderwaffe DG-2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c0d5951196795c04cfa0ca967dbdac6893155b92.jpg

Take a more electrifying approach to your undead denizen disposal with the original Wonder Weapon: The Wunderwaffe DG-2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e45306b7e2f16e74fdb8e3d42fe7fd24099d60d.jpg

Capable of striking down hordes with chain-lightning blasts, this has the bonus effect of stunning crowds of zombies, usually resulting in additional, and eventually terminal damage. The only real drawback to the weapon that users have experienced is the stench of electrified undead.
Shattered Veil: Additional Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1da51e6fe23ab3f5f4b7df6f8fb258449a3731dc.jpg

Main Quest and Quest Rewards: The Main Quest for Shattered Veil goes live when the map releases with Season 03 on April 2. Complete the Main Quest to earn the “PhDeadly” Operator Skin for Carver, an animated Calling Card, and 5,000 XP. Players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode arrives for Shattered Veil will also earn a unique Calling Card variant.

Microwave Trap: Burst zombies with microwaves for a mere 750 Essence. Get a horde of followers on your tail and then flip the switch.

Dark Aether Field Generator: Dissolve zombies with Dark Aether energy in a static field that zaps anything that passes through. Circle the trap to entice enemies into the center of it.

Lore and Intel: Dig deeper into the history of Colton Hall and other lore related to Shattered Veil with Intel in the form of Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts discovered throughout the map.
New Gameplay Content
Access the following new content within Shattered Veil as well as The Tomb, Citadelle des Morts, Terminus, and Liberty Falls.
Additional Perk-a-Cola: Double Tap
Available: In-Game at Perk Machine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/37b1fef2a6ebacbfdd860b2c2ae329d1c59ceff5.jpg

The classic rapid-fire Perk returns for the first time in nearly a decade, dramatically increasing your weapon’s fire rate to chew through enemy hordes in record time. Research the iconic Perk for powerful enhancements like an even faster fire rate and the chance to inflict double damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/83b37cee91bb27ea39e5dc001e8cdd3ad5a92dc1.jpg
	Double Tap is available in Shattered Veil along with the other previously accessible Zombies Perks. Note that some of these Perk-a-Colas are only available via the Der Wunderfizz machine.	Double Tap is available on The Tomb, Citadelle des Morts, Liberty Falls and Terminus maps via the Der Wunderfizz machine.Double Tap: Major Augments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dc05a5b8b76b373511f971b831442b9a129d2675.jpg

Research the following Augments to further customize the Perk.

Double Jeopardy

Normal zombies at low health have a chance to die immediately when shot.

Double Impact

Double hits on the same target in quick succession deal more damage.

Double Standard

All non-critical shots do double damage. Only applies to normal bullet weapons.
Double Tap: Minor Augments
Double Time

Increases fire rate bonus.

Double or Nothing

Weapons have a chance to do double damage but also have a chance to do zero damage.

Double Play

Killing two enemies in quick succession has a chance to return two rounds to your magazine. Only applies to normal bullet weapons.
New GobbleGums
Enjoy three new GobbleGums available across all maps once acquired and equipped in your GobbleGum Loadout Pack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76369cfd88cdea70c75613bc72497976b0f9b504.jpg

Tactical Diffusion (Rare): Disables the next Nuke Power-Up explosion you activate and gives everyone 2,000 Essence instead.

Support Group (Legendary): Gobble up this tasty GobbleGum to acquire the ARC-XD, Mangler Cannon, Sentry Gun and Mutant Injection Support items.

Die Pitched (Whimsical): Zombies have high-pitched voices. Lasts three minutes.
Additional Support Scorestreak: Death Machine
Available: Event Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03a693c5ccc6eb00d6bf123f75fc8a0c8f29ac32.jpg

Salvage: 1,750

Head to the Support tab at the Crafting Table to piece together the Death Machine, a powerful machine gun with a fast fire rate, high penetration, and a large magazine. Mow through multiple zombies with an all-time favorite, once you unlock this heavy weapon during the Black Ops Tribute Event.
Shattered Veil: Directed Mode and Events
For adventures seeking extra guidance in completing the Main Quest on Shattered Veil, jump into Directed Mode arriving at the Mid-Season, as well as the following additional Modes:
Team Cranked (Launch Window)
Following the awesome collaboration that introduced Cranked to Black Ops 6 in the last season, the high-octane mode returns for more in Season 03 with a team-focused twist: now the Cranked Timer is shared across the whole team and any kill from any team member fills it! Eliminate a zombie to activate the Cranked state, powering up your Operator with improved abilities and setting a countdown timer that can only be replenished by eliminating more enemies.

The rules are simple:
	The Cranked Timer starts when the first enemy is eliminated.	The timer starts at 30 seconds. Each enemy eliminated replenishes the timer to its current maximum, and every round survived causes the maximum timer to be reduced by 1 second.	Essence earned by eliminating zombies is increased compared to Standard/Directed.	The Time Stopper Field Upgrade replaces your loadout’s Field Upgrade.	Main Quests and Easter Eggs are enabled.
Use the following abilities to keep the timer from hitting zero:
	Time Stopper: Temporarily pause the Cranked timer for all teammates. All Operators begin the match with the Time Stopper Field Upgrade equipped.	Time Extended: Grab this rare power-up to add a small amount to the maximum time allowed.
Wall Buys are disabled in this mode, so the Mystery Box is your source for new weapons in Team Cranked. Because Operators gain increased Essence while Cranked, you’ll have plenty of chances to “spin the Box” for high-powered weapons! Good luck.

Team Cranked also delivers some tantalizing rewards for players who can survive past Round 50 on each map while this limited-time mode is available:
	A custom selection of six GobbleGums per map.			Each contains one high-rarity and five GobbleGums of other rarities.			15,000 XP per map, or a total of 75,000 XP across all maps.New LTM and Field Upgrade (Mid-Season)
Plus, whet your appetite with the Zombie Snacks Limited-Time Mode arriving later in the season, and put a chill on the undead using the Frost Blast Field Upgrade!

Jay & Silent Bob Deliver, LLC

For more information, please visit www.callofduty.com and www.youtube.com/callofduty, and follow @Activision and @CallofDuty on X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow @CODUpdates on X (formerly Twitter).

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 03: What you need to know, part 2
notes.content:
Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c35c81abfcba32d19a47b0494d0aff0a5cbddae0.jpg
[table]			[tr]			[td]			Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Return to Verdansk: Deploy to the big map that started it all as Verdansk returns to Call of Duty: Warzone. Consult the associated Blogs for more details.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Weapons Detail: Earn six new weapons throughout Season 03, including four available at launch and revealed here: the Kilo 141 and CR-56 AMAX Assault Rifles, the HDR Sniper Rifle, and the Kali Sticks Melee Weapon. Customize your weapons with the Monolithic Suppressor other attachments. Plus, unlock the Nail Gun and the new Ladra SMG later in the season.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Battle Pass and BlackCell: The Season 03 Battle Pass brings new Weapon Blueprints, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, Emotes, and more in a mix of free and premium tiers. Free tiers include two new base weapons and two attachments, including the Monolithic Suppressor.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Season 03 Operators: R0-Z3, Hudson & Mace answer the call to Verdansk as headliners for BlackCell and the Battle Pass, respectively. Plus, Jay and Silent Bob — as well as Bluntman and Chronic — deploy to the Store along with other Bundles you don’t want to miss.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
Free Trial, AMD Graphics Card Update: Play Black Ops 6 for free on April 2! And for PC players using the AMD Radeon RX 9070/9070XT, prepare for enhanced visuals and improved performance with the FSR 4 update.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]Return to Verdansk
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/96f19b0f2787be3efa300c450704741cd8a9793c.jpg

The Battle Royale Map that started it all is back! Get all the details about Call of Duty®: Warzone’s™ original Big Map, including a recon of this massive Big Map, the features, original gameplay modes, the new coastal POIs, plus details on the huge launch Event with 20 free rewards by the following blogs:

Read This Now: Return to Verdansk Call of Duty: Warzone Content

Read This Now: Tour of Verdansk

Read This Now: Verdansk Tac-Atlas

Equip your Kilo 141, CR-56 AMAX and HDR, and drop in on April 3 at 9AM, one day after the launch of Black Ops 6 Season 03 on April 2! Check further down the blog on the launch schedule.
Weapons DetailPrimary Weapon: Kilo 141 (Launch)
Assault Rifle, Call of Duty: Warzone Login Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c1bbb4fbeb00123bcb8917dcdae6b88c97999d0.jpg

Levels: 42

MAGS: 3

MAG SIZE: 30

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

Customize Options: Skins, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

Fully automatic assault rifle with an ergonomic design that improves handling, and a steady fire rate helps stay on target.

The Kilo 141 is back and ready to tear it up across Multiplayer and Call of Duty: Warzone. The weapon’s smooth handling, manageable recoil, and steady fire rate give it room to shine in a variety of combat situations, leaving no doubt as to why the Kilo 141 was a favorite in Verdansk. Now that the location is back, it’s time to relive the glory days with this hard-hitting Primary Weapon.

Players will automatically unlock the Kilo 141 for use in Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone after logging in to Call of Duty: Warzone at the launch of Season 03.
Primary Weapon: CR-56 AMAX (Launch)
Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 6 HVT Tier Reward, Completion Page Battle Pass Blueprint

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/750742473d3cb844261f13ce6fc8f52fa0c87e8a.jpg

Levels: 42

MAGS: 3

MAG SIZE: 30

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

Customize Options: Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

This lightweight 7.62 x 39mm full-auto assault rifle is compact and powerful. Built exclusively for military use, the standard issue rifle is deadly at mid-range combat and easily configured for a variety of assault tactics.

Combining high-damage hits with a fast fire rate and good handling, the CR-56 AMAX is the perfect mid-range weapon for downing targets fast. Eliminate enemies in three to four shots up to 25 meters out, leaving plenty left over to chew through equipped armor. Quick reloads get you back into the action fast, a helpful trait no matter how you choose to customize the weapon via Gunsmith.
Primary Weapon: HDR (Launch)
Sniper Rifle, Battle Pass Page 3 HVT Tier Reward, Page 11 Battle Pass Blueprint

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/17d746d8233c1d72fe0df9db6f3bcf6f0ffd1ac3.jpg

Levels: 38

MAGS: 3

MAG SIZE: 5

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

Customize Options: Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

Anti-material bolt action sniper rifle chambered in 12.7 x 108mm ammunition. Bullets have a lower muzzle velocity but remain devastating even at very long ranges.

Veterans of Verdansk know the power of the HDR and the havoc a sniper can inflict with it when stationed in high vantage points like the infamous Airport Control Tower. The weapon’s long reach and heavy damage make it a favorite of sharpshooters, its distinctive firing sound sending squads running. Add the Reinforced Barrel attachment to further extend your damage range and bullet velocity, and don’t forget to hold your breath for difficult shots.
Melee Weapon: Kali Sticks (Launch)
Melee, Event Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/34464f7174937a89cd680e1aa354da9876ffde23.jpg

Levels: 30

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: None

Customize Options: Camos (MP, ZM, WZ).

Two-hit kill. Extremely fast attack speed. Short range.

The infamous Kali Sticks return, dealing out damage with rapid swings that’ll take down your target in a flash. Smack them with fast follow-up hits using the weapon’s light attack or take them out in a more dramatic fashion by unleashing the heavy attack. Use Kali Sticks in Multiplayer with the new Close Shave Perk to deploy a quick whack against enemies without having to manually swap to your Dedicated Melee slot first.
Primary Weapon: Ladra (Mid-Season)
Submachine Gun, Event Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8c49842544a55b839eeec1ba2f9ebeeb5021a77b.jpg

Levels: 37

MAGS: 4

MAG SIZE: 38

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

Customize Options: Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

Full-auto submachine gun. Extreme rate of fire, excellent range, and low recoil. Headshots can help offset lower base damage.

What this SMG lacks in power it more than makes up for with a blistering fire rate that’s effective even in mid-range fights due to the weapon’s low recoil. Consider an Extended Mag to cut down on reloads and aim for the head to improve your damage output. Pairs well with Scavenger and the Assault Pack, giving you the ammo reserves you need to keep up the pressure and continue spitting out damage.
Special Weapon: Nail Gun (In-Season)
Special, Event Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c5c95dd9fa4f638a7aeb6e620bfef8242fe5f7e.jpg

Levels: 30

MAGS: 4

MAG SIZE: 15

Mastery Badges: Yes

Attachments: None

Customize Options: Camos (MP, ZM, WZ).

Full-auto Nail Gun. High damage at close range with fast handling speeds and very low muzzle velocity.

Stick it to them with this handy tool configured with a magazine of 15 nails that fires at full auto. The damage drops off quickly after 25 meters and performs best up close. The Nail Gun’s low muzzle velocity can make it difficult to land shots against fast moving targets, so get them in your sights and unload before they know what hit them. This armament is a reward earned during the Black Ops Tribute Event.
New: Weapon Attachments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3dc315b5132ddec5f3954f419e5d47d73dcfffe2.jpg
Monolithic Suppressor (Launch)
Assault Rifles (except AS VAL), SMGs, Shotguns, LMGs, Marksman Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Pistols, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward

Monolithic Core provides superior sound suppression and increased range. Moderate weight increase affects agility. The ideal attachment for extending your damage range on big maps like Verdansk while retaining the concealment provided by a suppressor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c67ca194479e0b82d8508225538be9510361973.jpg
SWAT 5.56 Grau Conversion (Launch)
SWAT 5.56 Marksman Rifle, Battle Pass Page 5 Reward

Convert the SWAT 5.56 into a fully automatic weapon with lower damage and range but improved accuracy, mobility, and handling. Equips a new default Barrel and Magazine and unlocks an exclusive 50-round extended Magazine. Blocks Barrel attachments.
C9 10mm Auto 30-Round Mags (In-Season)
C9 SMG, Event Reward

Conversion kit to use higher caliber 10mm Auto ammunition for increased stopping power. Though the conversion results in some increased recoil and a slightly lower fire rate, the extra damage, range, and velocity make this attachment a worthy consideration when approaching enemies on bigger maps.
Goblin Mk2 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion (Mid-Season)
Goblin Mk2 Assault Rifle, Event Reward

Converts the Goblin Mk2 into a fully automatic weapon with explosive rocket ammunition. Splash damage capabilities come at the expense of bullet velocity and rate of fire. Equips a new default barrel and magazine. Blocks Barrel, Muzzle, and Magazine Attachments.
New Features (MP, ZM, WZ)Base Blueprint Swap (Launch)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5898a9f15828d62b9d87297e616b2737c96c6349.jpg

You’re now able to customize any Black Ops 6 base weapon or Weapon Blueprint with a skin you’ve unlocked or purchased, across Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone.
	For Base Weapons, you can only change the skin of the Base Weapon, not any Attachments.	For Blueprints, you can customize the skins with other existing Attachments.
Camo Hub (Launch Window, MP/ZM)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e3c83f785ba5b712d8730ada7449d01e5a4e6b51.jpg

This new user-interface section is planned to be added shortly after launch, available in the Barracks > Challenges Menu. This allows you to view the challenges you need to complete to unlock Weapon Camos in a single location, with weapons sorted by furthest camo unlocked. Simply visit the Camo Hub to start planning out the next steps on your journey to Dark Matter and Nebula.
Season 03 Events
Season 03 delivers an assortment of scheduled Events across Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone. Earn rewards such as a new Primary Weapon, Melee Weapon, Launcher, new special attachments, and more.
Event: Return to Verdansk (WZ only)
Activation Dates: April 3 to 15

Free Event. Total Rewards: 20, including Instant unlocks for new and veteran players and the Kali Sticks Melee Weapon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8dc8d3cafadfefe4abe1e633197eba0a2bc22f20.jpg

Open Verdansk Safes across several unique locations to earn rewards. Players also have the chance to earn the “Trail Blazer” Operator Skin for Caine, if you can find the right safe to open before someone else gets there first.

As part of this event and to celebrate the return of Verdansk, all players who log in to Call of Duty: Warzone following the Season 03 launch will unlock the Kilo 141 plus two Operators exclusively for use in Call of Duty: Warzone. Players whose Activision ID matches those who deployed to the original Verdansk map will also receive three additional items when logging in after the update: the “Blue Legacy” Contrails, “Coming Home” Parachute, and “Like We Never Left” Gun Screen.

For all the details on this Event, check out the Return to Verdansk Blog.

Event: Black Ops Tribute (MP, ZM, WZ)
Activation Dates: April 17 to May 1

Total Rewards: 17, including the Death Machine Scorestreak, Nail Gun Special Weapon, Close Shave Perk, and Thermite Lethal

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b7c4121bd97d23a7b6e1acb8d73f31fe7f30b40.jpg

Don’t miss out on this legendary tribute to Black Ops in an event stuffed with rewards that honor the history of the series.

Earn XP in any mode to progress the Event and earn Black Ops themed rewards. Black Ops 6 owners will receive additional rewards only available to use in Black Ops 6.

Earn cosmetic content and functional equipment, including the Nail Gun (Special Weapon), C9 10mm Auto 30-Round Mags (Attachment), Thermite (Lethal in Call of Duty: Warzone), Death Machine (Scorestreak in MP/Support in Zombies), Close Shave (MP Perk), an Emote, GobbleGums, and the fan-requested Operator, “John Black Ops”.

More in the Mid-Season: Look for more events and rewards throughout Season 03, including the Blaze of Glory Event and the Call of Duty Endowment Got Your Six Event. Expect more event coverage in the Season 03 Reloaded announcement.
Season 03 Battle Pass and BlackCellHudson and Mace Lead the Charge in the Season 03 Battle Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81c1591b6bb5ec78b1f14db0f34d1c4a29445611.jpg

Memories are a powerful tool, and even the departed can change the course of history. The road back to Verdansk involves unlocking some core memories, as well as some unforgettable weaponry and new Operators. A flashback to agent Jason Hudson, bringing echoes of his frontline savvy, Hudson is unlockable by progressing within the Battle Pass. Joining him is Mace, the metal-faced mercenary, who will bring the war anywhere, anytime, for anyone, unlocked instantly upon Battle Pass purchase.

Purchase the Season 03 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 03 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to immediately unlock the Instant Rewards Page of the Battle Pass, including the following items:
	The new Mace Operator and “Mace BlackCell” Mace Skin for those who purchase BlackCell	10% Battle Pass XP Boost	The “Day Ones” Legendary Weapon Sticker	The “Package Received” Finishing Move
The “Marbled” Legendary Blueprint for the Saug SMG

The Season 03 Battle Pass includes over 110 pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including free, earnable armaments; two new Base Weapons, the Monolithic Suppressor Attachment, and more. Check out the BlackCell, Battle Pass and Store Bundles blog prior to Season 03 launch for a closer look at what’s coming.
BlackCell Offerings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a0ff9cd2f008b223458b485ad19e424362aa16a8.jpg

The new BlackCell Operator R0-Z3 arrives in an animated mantle and her signature mask along with her faithful hound, leading an awesome array of Season 03 BlackCell content. She is joined by a roster of teched out Operator Skins, sleek Weapon Blueprints, and sci-fi themed unlocks earned exclusively through BlackCell.

BlackCell owners can access the Season 03 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:
	BlackCell Daily Challenges (MP, ZM, WZ, see below)	10% XP Boost	1,100 COD Points	The “Martial Arts” Emote	The “Energy Siphon” Mastercraft Blueprint for the XM4 Assault Rifle	The “Goodest Boy” Companion Finishing Move	The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)	The “R0-Z3” BlackCell Operator
BlackCell owners get access to page after page of additional exclusive rewards within the Season 03 Battle Pass, including:
	Ten BlackCell-exclusive skins for Mace (two skins), Hudson (two skins), Woods, Maya, Park, Marshall, Stone, and Toro.	Six BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the Feng 82 (LMG), GPMG-7 (LMG), Tanto .22 (SMG), ASG-89 (Shotgun), HDR (Sniper Rifle), and the CR-56 AMAX (Assault Rifle).	Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 03 BlackCell Battle Pass.
As usual, players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

BlackCell Stackable XP Boost: Players who purchased BlackCell in a previous Black Ops 6 season and go on to purchase Season 03 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus, now up to 20% for players who purchased Season 01 and Season 02 BlackCell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/59dd2e5ae4fa57b37924679a2f0af85ae31286aa.jpg

NEW! Extra Daily Challenges: Players with BlackCell will also receive an additional Daily Challenge throughout Season 03 for Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone, giving even more chances to rake in the XP during your play sessions!
Operators
Season 03 and the return of Verdansk brings out six new Operators with plentiful combat experience in the area: The main three Operators include R0-Z3, who leads the BlackCell roster while Mace and Hudson headline the Battle Pass alongside a variety of other Operator Skins for both factions.
R0-Z3 (BlackCell, Crimson One, Launch)
“R0-Z3” Skin: BlackCell Instant Reward Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/01865d5c4376c2433614d70142dc44db8a7a458e.jpg

R0-Z3 returns to claim her status as a top BlackCell operative working in Verdansk. You know the drill. No witnesses.
Hudson (Battle Pass, Rogue Black Ops, Launch)
“Hudson” and “Hudson BlackCell” Operator Skins: Battle Pass HVT, Page 2.

“Icebreaker” and “Icebreaker BlackCell” Operator Skins: Battle Pass HVT, Page 14.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54d059d3e20af36777975d81894d5f9a0bacffcc.jpg

Special Agent Jason Hudson, CIA operative, handler to Alex Mason, and KIA during Operation False Profit.
Mace (Battle Pass, Crimson One, Launch)
“Mace” and “Mace BlackCell” Operator Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page

“Apocalypse King” and “Apocalypse King BlackCell” Operator Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, Battle Pass Page 12

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73a26fefdc4c97c30fe129d7beb14ccd43189374.jpg

The Special Forces Army Ranger turned PMC returns, ready to inflict serious damage on anyone who thinks they can best him in Verdansk.
John Black Ops (Event Reward for Black Ops 6 owners, In-Season)
“[REDACTED]” Operator Skin: Black Ops Tribute Event Reward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c7611bdf15077bd0c596f09e5475b127411761e8.jpg

A mysterious Operator clad in a gray jump suit, sporting tactical goggles and helmet. Anonymous. Unassuming. Deadly.
Jay and Silent Bob (Bundles, Rogue Black Ops, In-Season)
Store Bundles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3e7325371d815181d0daf4bc57427ed9d6362181.jpg

The iconic duo returns to loiter in front of the (Super) Store and cause trouble for passing Operators. Deploy in their classic look or as their comic book alter egos Bluntman and Chronic, arriving just in time to celebrate their favorite April holiday.
New Store Offerings
Check out some of the Bundles coming to the Store in Season 03. Look for more intel in the Season 03 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles blog arriving before launch.
Tracer Pack: Jay and Silent Bob
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c41c41f41c2d216345cc0acd68313f951efcfd81.jpg

Bring some mischief to your matches with the “Jay” and “Silent Bob” Operator Skins, deploying with the “Doobie Wreck” LW3A1 Frostline Sniper Rifle and the “Golden Calf” Kompakt 92 SMG, both featuring Blue and Yellow Tracers and Smoke Death FX. For closer encounters, show them who owns the block with the “Gimme a Light” Finishing Move.

Celebrate the high life and take back what’s yours with the “Poppin’ Off” Emote, “Mooby’s” Weapon Charm, animated “In Sync” Calling Card, “Mooby Joint” Large Decal, and the animated “Snoochie Boochie” Emblem. There’s a new duo in town; they’ve been to Hollywood and now these two guys from Jersey are ready for the limelight of Call of Duty.
Tracer Pack: Bluntman and Chronic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b4f7f94641b8cfbcb2de2b4b7a5d349e85edb4c.jpg

The blunt-tastic heroes unite as their comic book alter egos. Deploy as “Bluntman” or “Chronic” with the choice of three doobie-themed Weapon Blueprints for their enjoyment: the “Bluntman Stuntman” Krig C Assault Rifle and “Chronic Unapologetic” Jackal PDW SMG with Pink and Purple Tracers and Joint Leaf Death FX, and the “Bong Staff” Bo Staff with Joint Leaf Death FX.

Straight from the Bluntcave’s arsenal, beat competition with the “Smoke You Out” Finishing Move and show your love for the chronic with the “Did that Happen?” Emote, animated “Joint Power” Calling Card, animated “Blunts Out, Suit Up” Emblem, and the “Doobage Duo” Spray.
Tracer Pack: Digital Dreamin’ Reactive Mastercraft Ultra Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ffb50ee67b442833e93d94d18f77a3bbf1e88948.jpg

Hone your gaming skills with top-of-the-line equipment headlined by the Ultra Mastercraft “Game Over” Assault Rifle for the new CR-56 AMAX, featuring Starstruck Tracers and VR Knockout Death FX along with the Monolithic Suppressor and a new inspect animation that morphs the weapon into a game console. Wield it as the “Pixel” Operator Skin equipped with a Reactive headset and augmented reality tattoos and the gamified “K.O.” Finishing Move.

Engage distant targets with the “Pixel Precise!” SVD Sniper Rifle, also featuring Starstruck Tracers and VR Knockout Death FX. Show them they’re not on your level with the “Eezee” Weapon Charm, animated “Monkey Business” Emblem, animated “It’s Over” Calling Card, “Not on My Level” Spray, “XD” Emote, and “Logging In” Loading Screen.
Other Incoming Bundles
